The modalities were measured on different individuals, so nothing can be matched sample to sample.
What connects them is a fixed vocabulary of named biological concepts: a concept is a set of
features that belong together for a stated biological reason, every modality is scored on the same
concepts, and a concept is the same concept in every modality. The six steps below run in a fixed
order, and the order is part of the method.

## 1. Fix the vocabulary

`chorale_concepts()` builds the vocabulary for a collection and reports its coverage. Genes and
proteins reach a concept through their identifiers, mapped to a common identifier space by
`chorale_map()`. Lipid species reach the same concept through their class, since a pathway acts on a
class rather than on one chain length.

Coverage is reported rather than assumed. For every concept and every modality, the number of
features that modality carries for it is recorded, and a modality is counted as expressing a concept
only above a stated number of features. The counts expressible in every modality, in a subset, and
in none are what the vocabulary can and cannot carry for this collection.

## 2. Score every modality on the vocabulary

`chorale_encode()` gives each sample one number per concept: the average standardised level of the
features carrying that concept in that sample. The scores are standardised afterwards, so an effect
on a large concept and an effect on a small one are on one scale.

Nothing in this step reads the design. The concept scores therefore cannot have been shaped by the
contrast they are tested on in step 4.

## 3. Keep what the vocabulary misses

The concept scores are projected out of the assay and independent component analysis is run on what
remains. Those free dimensions carry coordinated variation no concept explains. Because the
projection is onto the space the concept scores span, the residual is exactly orthogonal to every
concept score, so a free dimension cannot absorb concept signal.

How many free dimensions a modality supports is decided by reproducibility rather than by variance.
`chorale_select_factors()` runs the decomposition repeatedly at each candidate count, from different
initialisations and on subsamples of the samples, matches the components one to one, and takes the
largest count at which the weakest component still clears a declared threshold. Parallel analysis
sets the upper bound the selection is held to.

## 4. Ask the design whether each concept separates cases from controls

`chorale_concept_evidence()` regresses each concept score on the design within each modality. The
model carries the phenotype and every covariate the modalities share and can jointly estimate, so
the reported phenotype effect is adjusted for them. Continuous covariates enter as standardised
slopes, categorical ones as treatment contrasts on their shared levels.

The modalities are combined by inverse-variance weighting. A modality that measures a concept
precisely counts for more than one that measures it loosely, and effects in opposite directions
cancel rather than accumulate, so a concept the modalities disagree about cannot reach a large
combined statistic by accumulating disagreement. How far they agree is reported beside the combined
statistic, because a statistic carried by one modality against the others is a different finding
from the same statistic carried by all of them.

## 5. Calibrate against a null that keeps the design

The quantity under test is the phenotype coefficient of a model that also carries the covariates the
modalities share, so the null has to be a null for that coefficient. Permuting the phenotype label
would break its relation to those covariates as well, and the permuted designs would be designs the
study could not have produced.

The design is therefore held fixed and the response is what moves. The model without the phenotype
is fitted, its residuals are exchanged, and they are added back to what that model explains. This is
the null of Freedman and Lane (1983): the phenotype keeps exactly the relation to the covariates the
data give it, and only the part of the score those covariates do not explain is exchanged. Samples
are exchanged freely unless the study declares which of them are exchangeable, since a repeated
measure or a processing batch is a fact about the study rather than something a design table can be
read for.

The encoder is never refitted, so the number of permutations is a choice about the resolution the
report needs rather than about what a refit can afford.

Two levels of error control come from the same permutations. The family-wise p-value compares each
concept with the largest statistic anywhere in the vocabulary, which is exact under the dependence
that overlapping concepts have. The q-value is the false discovery rate that null implies at the
same threshold.

## 6. Separate a concept from its neighbourhood

Curated concepts share features, so a signal in one appears in every concept overlapping it. Each
concept is therefore reported a second time with its overlapping neighbours regressed out of its
score. A concept whose statistic survives that carries the signal itself; one whose statistic
collapses is reporting the neighbourhood it sits in.

## What the free dimensions add

The concept channel is fitted first, so the free dimensions hold only what is orthogonal to every
concept score. `chorale_free_dimensions()` tests each of them against the same permutations and
names the features loading on it most heavily. A dimension called there is a candidate outside the
vocabulary, described by its features and not identified by them.
